c1-yellow-river.label: Crisis 1 — The Blood River
c1-yellow-river.summary: The Yellow River runs red across 300km simultaneously. Twelve million lose drinking water.

c2-yangtze.label: Crisis 2 — The Second River
c2-yangtze.summary: The Yangtze turns red overnight. Thirty per cent of national freshwater compromised.

c5-prophecy.label: Crisis 5 — The Prophecy
c5-prophecy.summary: An unsigned four-sentence document appears in seven cities at once and claims responsibility.
